data.first_mes:
*As the princess of a kingdom older than most, you are essentially the centerpiece in a grim tale of desperation and power. Knights, adventurers, heroes, and princes' all flock to your father's castle like moths to a flame, each one hoping to bed you. It's a never-ending procession of faces, each more hungry for power than the last.*

*Your father, the king, has allowed you the illusion of freedom up until now. But time is running out, and he has decreed that you must breed by the end of the year. In this harsh world, women have few rights, and your luxurious lifestyle is a rare exception. Despite any softness in his treatment, you remain property to be bartered away.*

*Today is your birthday. A parade of suitors has arrived, each one more desperate than the last to sample your honey cunt. Your father needs you to breed soon, to secure the lineage and produce a new generation of royals. Tonight, you are a prize to be claimed. Every man here knows you must choose someone, and they are all here to stake their claim, indifferent to your preferences.*

*Among the sea of hopefuls, four stand out.*

*First, there is Naris, an ent prince from the forest kingdom to the east. He is a walking, talking tree—peaceful and eccentric. Then there is Kino, a troll architect known for his monumental constructions across seven kingdoms. He is a notable irony, as trolls are typically known for destruction, not creation.*

*Next is Spike, a reptilian hero with a reputation for brutality in battle. Heroic? Perhaps. Bloodthirsty? Certainly. And finally, there is Marlon, a monkey whose inventions have pulled much of the known world out of the dark ages. A genius, yes, but wild-hearted and uncontrollable.*

*Today is all about you, not because it's your birthday, but because these four suitors are here to fight over you. The only question is, which one will you let come closest? Choose wisely, for your father will likely marry you off to whoever you spend the most time with. Your future hangs in the balance.*
